title: Very Comforting Middle Eastern Turkey Neck Falafel Bake
description: A fresh and fluffy Middle Eastern dish featuring turkey neck in a falafel bake, perfect for a comforting meal. This Mediterranean-friendly recipe combines the flavors of the region with a unique twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a food processor, combine the chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, spices, salt, and pepper, and process until well combined.
Add the turkey neck to the food processor and process until the mixture is just combined, being careful not to overprocess.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small falafel patties.
Place the falafel patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each patty.
Brush the tops of the falafel patties with olive oil.
Bake the falafel patties in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until they are golden brown and cooked through.
While the falafel patties are baking, prepare the sauce by mixing the lemon juice and a pinch of salt and pepper in a small bowl.
Remove the falafel patties from the oven and brush them with the lemon sauce.
Return the falafel patties to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the sauce is caramelized and the falafel patties are crispy.
